theorems.name: Rayleigh.sq_nonneg
theorems.runtime_counterpart: float Fiedler estimate is compared against exact quotients; PSD is why xᵀLx ≥ 0

theorems.name: Rayleigh.quad_nonneg
theorems.statement: quad edges x >= 0 (Laplacian quadratic form is PSD)

theorems.name: Rayleigh.quad_const
theorems.statement: quad edges (fun _ => c) = 0 (constants are in the kernel)

theorems.name: Rayleigh.quad_shift
theorems.statement: quad edges (x + b) = quad edges x
theorems.runtime_predicate: centering a vector does not change xᵀLx

theorems.name: Rayleigh.quad_scale
theorems.runtime_predicate: scaling a vector scales xᵀLx by c²

theorems.name: Rayleigh.ind_sq_diff
theorems.statement: (1_S a − 1_S b)² = edgeCut S a b
theorems.runtime_predicate: per-edge term of an indicator is 0 or 1

theorems.name: Rayleigh.quad_indicator
theorems.runtime_predicate: xᵀLx of a 0/1 indicator equals the number of cut edges

theorems.name: Rayleigh.edgeCut_singleton_untouched
theorems.statement: edge not touching v has edgeCut [v] = 0

theorems.name: Rayleigh.cut_singleton_untouched
theorems.statement: no edge touches v ⇒ cut edges [v] = 0
theorems.runtime_predicate: an isolated vertex has no cut edges

theorems.name: Rayleigh.quad_no_incident
theorems.statement: no edge touches v ⇒ quad edges (1_{v}) = 0 (isolated vertex indicator is in the kernel)

theorems.name: Rayleigh.witness_numerator
theorems.statement: x = n·1_S − k·1 ⇒ quad edges x = n²·cut edges S
theorems.runtime_predicate: numerator of the exact rational Rayleigh–Ritz witness

theorems.name: Rayleigh.witness_denominator
theorems.runtime_predicate: denominator of the exact rational Rayleigh–Ritz witness

nonclaims: nullity(L) = number of connected components is NOT proved (needs finite-dimensional linear algebra); the runtime reports BFS components and states the identity
the Fiedler value lambda_2 is a float power-iteration estimate; nothing here certifies it, only the exact rational Rayleigh-Ritz witness it is compared against
Ky Fan's maximum principle (tr(X^T C X) <= lambda_1 + lambda_2) is NOT proved here; the runtime reports the frozen-frame gap as a measurement
no statement about embedding semantics, task quality, or whether any document should be kept or reverted
Rayleigh's inviscid stability equation and the Rayleigh-Plesset equation are not used: they need real analysis and describe physical systems the instrument does not measure
